name: Weather station
description: The home screen of a mountain weather service: the current reading set very large, the week ahead, snow stakes, wind rose and barometer in a row, then radar beside the active alerts.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in person at the foot of the navigation column. Without an avatar it shows initials.

props.name: radarMap
props.description: Image drawn under the radar, such as a contour map of the area. Without one the radar sits on a plain well.

props.name: towns
props.type: { name: string; x: number; y: number }[]
props.description: Place names marked on the radar, positioned in percent of its width and height. Defaults to five towns around Hakuba.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls; below 1024px the navigation column moves into a drawer. Also accepts every other div attribute.
